calculation.description: For each date, rank each tradable asset by its 3-, 5-, and 10-session return across the available cross-section, then take the negative average percentile rank. Lower recent performers receive higher reversal scores. Cross-sectional ranks avoid price-level and scale effects.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC was positive in 2020-2022 (+0.0568865), 2023-2024 (+0.0892454), and 2025-2027 (+0.0223517); recent ICIR weakened below the aggregate ICIR. Small cross-section requires conservative interpretation.
